dashboard.title: Content pipeline
dashboard.emptyTitle: Follow one Episode from Brief to pull request.
dashboard.emptyBody: Agents research, specify and build each Episode; I decide at every Gate. This page replays that pipeline from two files. Open the demo to see a finished Run, or choose your own docs/episodes/<slug> folder. Your files stay on this device; nothing is uploaded.
dashboard.compatibility: Folder access needs Chrome or Edge. Choose a folder to grant read-only access for this page.
dashboard.unsupported: This page needs Chrome or Edge with the File System Access API. Open it there to choose a local folder.
dashboard.pipelineFile: Job graph, agent configuration and human Gates.
dashboard.eventsFile: Append-only Run history, checked about every 2 seconds.
dashboard.error: Source needs attention · View may be stale
dashboard.order: Ordered by needs. Wants are optional dependencies; their failure does not block a Job.
dashboard.gateHelp: An open Gate needs your decision. This dashboard cannot approve it or change your files.
dashboard.reload: Folder access is kept only in memory. Reloading returns to the picker.

chips.title: Skills and checks
chips.label: {kind} {name}: {state}
chips.help: From pipeline.yml. A skill turns green once an agent of this Job's latest Attempt invokes it, red once that agent ended without it; a check by its latest result. The node popover shows a skill green once every agent listing it ran it, red if any skipped it.

timeTravel.keyboard: Drag or click the progress bar to replay. Arrow keys move one minute; Page Up and Down ten. Home goes to the start; End resumes Live.
timeTravel.replaying: Replaying from the events read so far. New events are still read; turn Live on to follow them. Outputs open as they are on disk now, not as they were then.

graph.title: Run progress
graph.showJobsHelp: Show branching Jobs and their consecutive agents, ordered by needs and wants. Scroll inside the graph to follow all stages.
graph.followHelp: Off by default. Scrolling away pauses following.
graph.eventLegend: Start opens a Span. End closes it. Score records a verdict; it does not close a Span. The latest end determines status. Events are ordered by timestamp, then sequence.
graph.localLog: Local events.jsonl only. Raw records may contain private prompts or paths; nothing is uploaded.
graph.stale: Source is stale; activity animation is paused.

failure.continued: Went on without it: {jobs}. Wants are non-blocking, so this failure did not stop them.
failure.notContinued: Nothing has gone on without it yet.

graph.openOutput: opens as plain text in a new tab
graph.previewHelp: this Job's dev server, opens in a new tab
graph.specHelp: the Run's Spec server, opens in a new tab

dashboard.intro: How an Episode gets made: from Brief to pull request, every agent Job, human Gate and review score in one view.
dashboard.demoNote: A recorded Run of the Episode “Onboard AI every time”, replayed from saved files. Nothing here is live, and its output files are not included.
